Learned grasps, localized handle and rim attempts, wrist changes, base repositioning, door-clearance recovery, and scripted fallback failed to establish reliable reach and enclosure; geometric servo commands repeatedly deviated from targets. Audit saved as SearingMeat_target_s1361.json.

arguments.summary: Final official success is false, with neither lemon nor ice contained. Counter recoveries achieved temporary placements, but the remaining visible ice cube fell to the floor; controlled descents from two base stances stalled or diverged above it, and full-body pickup also failed to contact or lift it.
